plugin.note: Requires Reptile got ripped. Use cannon plus melee or ranged in Lizardman Canyon for normal tasks; use Lizardman shaman strategy separately for the dragon warhammer route.

requirements: Reptile got ripped must be unlocked for Chaeldar, Konar, Nieve, and Duradel to assign Lizardmen.
mechanics: Normal Lizardmen and Lizardman brutes are straightforward combat targets.
Lizardman shamans are a separate profit method with special attacks and dragon warhammer drop chance.

methods.label: Normal Lizardman task
methods.summary: Use cannon support and direct combat in Lizardman Canyon for regular Lizardman or Lizardman brute tasks.
recommendedFor: fast task completion without shaman mechanics
steps: Go to Lizardman Canyon or another assigned lizardman location.
Set up a cannon where allowed.
Kill Lizardmen or Lizardman brutes with melee or ranged.
Switch to the Lizardman shaman strategy only if choosing the dragon warhammer route.

methods.label: Lizardman brute task
methods.summary: Kill Lizardman brutes when regular Lizardmen are crowded or when using locations that mix both task-counting variants.
recommendedFor: players using Shayzien or Kebos lizardman areas
steps: Use a location with Lizardman brutes such as Lizardman Canyon, Lizardman Settlement, Kebos Swamp, Battlefront, Molch, or south of Xeric's Shrine.
Use melee or ranged depending on safespot access and supply goals.
Bring antipoison or other poison handling where local lizardmen can poison.
notes: Lizardman brutes count for Lizardmen tasks after the Reptile got ripped unlock.
Brutes are stronger than regular lizardmen but use the same broad task strategy.

methods.label: Lizardman shaman route
methods.summary: Choose Lizardman shamans instead of normal lizardmen when pursuing the dragon warhammer drop and accepting shaman-specific mechanics.
recommendedFor: players choosing profit over simple task speed
Konar or regular Lizardmen tasks where shaman locations are valid
steps: Use Lizardman Canyon, Lizardman Caves, or Lizardman Temple when choosing shamans.
Switch from the normal lizardmen method to the dedicated Lizardman shaman strategy for movement, poison-spit, and spawn handling.
Prioritise ranged setups and maintain the location-specific protection required for shaman kills.
Treat the dragon warhammer drop chance as the reason to accept slower, more mechanical kills.
risks: Shamans require movement and special-attack handling that normal lizardmen do not.
Choosing shamans can slow task completion if the player only wants fast Slayer experience.
notes: The dedicated shaman strategy source is https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Lizardman_shaman/Strategies.
The task page lists Lizardman shamans as task-counting variants with 157.5 Slayer experience.

styleOptions.label: Melee
styleOptions.summary: Use standard melee gear for regular Lizardmen and brutes.

styleOptions.label: Ranged
styleOptions.summary: Use ranged when safespotting or avoiding melee damage.
